title: FFE-HALLU: Hallucinations in Fixed Figurative Expressions Benchmark of Idioms and Proverbs in the Persian Language
reasoning: The paper focuses on the linguistic evaluation of figurative hallucinations in LLMs using Persian idioms and proverbs. While proverbs often carry moral or cultural wisdom, the benchmark's objective is to evaluate linguistic accuracy and the detection of fabricated expressions rather than to benchmark religious beliefs, faith systems, or ethical frameworks.
